text:
stuti_k: Quick preflight for tomorrow's webinar — final checks on reg page, Zoom recording settings, and post-event lead routing. Can each owner confirm?

matt_p: I'm on reg page copy. Link: https://airtable.com/shrExample -> made two CTA variants (Attend Live / Get Replay). Need one more QA pass for GDPR checkbox.

leah_ops: Zoom settings I suggest: Record to cloud, automatic transcript (SRT), enable co-hosts, disable participant join before host. Co-hosts: @matt_p and @leah_ops.

jamal_sales: For lead routing: live attendees -> hubspot list "webinar_live_2026" + tag sales-touch=low. Replay viewers -> nurture-drip-3. Can we add a field on reg form for "product area of interest" to route to AE buckets?

stuti_k: Jamal yes — added a select field. Mapping in the sheet: Sales bucket = value. I'll paste mapping in a sec.

ryan_g: One more ask on recordings: please enable cloud recording + auto-clip marker on speaker switch if available. If not, we'll export the meeting and run the clipper job. Also export transcript to s3 path: s3://redwood-uploads/webinars/2026-05-12/

zoom-bot: Zoom meeting scheduled. Cloud recording: enabled. Auto-transcription: enabled. Meeting ID: 987654321. Recording link will be posted to #marketing when available.

matt_p: Copy QA complete. Two subject line variants for reminder email: 
1) "Quick question before the webinar — confirm your spot" 
2) "Tomorrow: Hands-on demo of Redwood inference (live Q&A)"
Which do we A/B in the reminder?

jamal_sales: Go with #2 for PLG audience, #1 for enterprise lists. We'll segment.

stuti_k: Noted. Also adding a short launch post narrative for social: benchmark highlight + CTA to replay. Draft: "We saw 2.3x latency improvement vs baseline in our scalebench — join our demo to see how we optimize LLM inference in production. Replay link after event." Thoughts?

ryan_g: Love the benchmark hook but avoid absolute numbers without context. Maybe: "Up to 2x lower latency in production workloads — see the demo." Keep it high level.

matt_p: I'll create two social copy variants and schedule. One will link to the registration page, one to the later replay.

leah_ops: Post-event handoff plan:
- Recording auto-posted to private S3 and posting link in #marketing once processed.
- Transcripts -> run QA for PII (cc @stuti_k).
- Clips: Top 3 highlights created by the clipper job, owner: @matt_p.
- HubSpot: attendee status + interest field -> trigger flows (sales/nurture).

stuti_k: I'll own the post-event email (to registrants): short thank you + replay + 3 clips + interest survey. Draft subject: "Thanks — replay and highlights from today's demo"

jamal_sales: Sales follow-up cadence: 
- Live attendees with demo interest -> AE within 24h.
- Replay viewers who open >1x or click pricing -> SDR outreach at 48h.
- Tagging rules are in the mapping sheet (see row 12).

ryan_g: Technical checklist for Zoom export (for eng ops):
```
- Download cloud recording (mp4)
- Download SRT transcript
- Run clipper: clipper --src recording.mp4 --markers transcript.srt --out clips/
- Upload clips to s3://redwood-marketing/clips/{event-date}/
```

matt_p: Small ops nit: please set recording retention to 90 days in Zoom so compliance can review if needed.

leah_ops: Done. Also set the webinar to require registration and disable attendee chat links (reduce spam).

stuti_k: Final asks before we close: who will monitor the chat during the webinar? And who confirms the recording link within 1 hour after end?

matt_p: I'll monitor chat with @ryan_g. @leah_ops will confirm the recording link and transcript delivery.

jamal_sales: I'll stand by for hot leads — keep a DM thread open with me if someone posts an enterprise question.

stuti_k: Awesome. Last check: tagging for analytics — please set utm params on the reg page: utm_source=twitter&utm_campaign=scalebench_demo_may.

ryan_g: Added. Everything else green from infra side.

zoom-bot: Reminder: webinar starts in 24 hours. Host(s): stuti_k. Co-host(s): matt_p, leah_ops.

stuti_k: Great job team — thanks. Post-event owners: @matt_p (clips + social), @stuti_k (email + replay), @jamal_sales (AE follow-ups), @leah_ops (recording + infra). See you after the show :rocket:
